strings.con instructor de Nómada Extremo. No est: with Nómada Extremo instructor. It is not available for free use for technical security. Check the available sessions and packs.
strings.Devolución si el material regresa en bue: Return if the material returns in good condition
strings.El alquiler puede ser para actividad gui: The rental can be for a guided activity with Nómada Extremo or, in some categories, for personal use with a previously validated level.
strings.El material se reserva junto a la activi: The material is reserved together with the activity or separately by checking availability. Always indicate size, approximate weight and expected duration of use.
strings.Indica tu talla al reservar: Please indicate your size when booking
strings.Los precios son orientativos y pueden va: Prices are indicative and may vary depending on season, condition of the material and duration. For rentals of several days a discount applies. The material is delivered checked and clean. The deposit is returned in full if the material returns in good condition. Any damage is assessed with the client before applying a charge. Always book in advance.
strings.Motor a reacción · Tabla · Equipo safety: Jet engine · Table · Complete safety equipment
strings.no se alquila de forma independiente. Si: It is not rented independently. It is always integrated into the guided experience with a certified instructor or requires prior special technical validation. No exceptions.
strings.paracaidismo, parapente, paramotor y pue: skydiving, paragliding, paramotoring and bungee jumping
strings.Solo en modalidad guiada con instructor: Only in guided mode with a Nomad instructor. They are not rented for independent free use for security reasons. Prior assessment of the user's level is required.
strings.Solo para actividad con guía o nivel val: Only for activities with a guide or validated level
strings.Todo el material de las nuevas disciplin: All the material for the new aquatic disciplines. E-foil, wingfoil and jetsurf are only rented in guided mode — always with a Nomad instructor. The initiation material can be rented with a prior introduction session.
strings.Bicicleta por talla, casco, kit de repar: Bicycle by size, helmet, repair kit, protections and navigation support.
strings.Casco, arnés, chaleco, pala, kayak, neop: Helmet, harness, vest, paddle, kayak, neoprene or other main equipment when the sheet indicates it.
strings.Casco, arnés, disipador, descensor, cuer: Helmet, harness, heatsink, descender, ropes and connectors according to discipline.
strings.Cuerdas, anclajes, material de rescate,: Ropes, anchors, rescue material, complete diving equipment, motorized foil and jumping systems.
strings.GoPro, 360, soportes y sistemas de sujec: GoPro, 360, authorized supports and fastening systems; drone/FPV only with operator.
strings.Kayak, pala, chaleco, bidón estanco, más: Kayak, paddle, vest, waterproof bottle, mask, fins, buoy and neoprene.
strings.La disponibilidad depende de la activida: Availability depends on activity, size, revision and level. This classification avoids confusing included material with free rental.
strings.Lo gestiona el profesional o proveedor r: It is managed by the responsible professional or provider.
strings.Máscara, aletas, traje, chaleco, regulad: Mask, fins, suit, vest, regulator, bottle and weight through an authorized center.
strings.Material no crítico como mochila, baston: Non-critical material such as backpack, poles, headgear, light neoprene, mask, fins or protections.
strings.Mochila, bastones, frontal, orientación,: Backpack, poles, frontal, orientation, bivouac and thermal protection.
strings.No se entrega fuera del programa contrat: It is not delivered outside the contracted program.
It is not provided for independent use.
strings.Parapente, paramotor, paratrike, paracaí: Paragliding, paramotor, paratrike, parachute, Rope Jumping, bungee jumping, jetsurfing and equipment subject to operator.
strings.Qué se entrega y cómo se usa: What is delivered and how to use it
strings.Requiere talla, fianza, revisión y devol: Requires size, deposit, inspection and return.
strings.Cada material se clasifica como incluido: Cada material se clasifica como incluido, alquilable, solo con técnico o no disponible libre. Las cifras son orientativas y dependerían de inventario, fianza, mantenimiento y responsable.
strings.El leash de seguridad adecuado al equipo: The safety leash suitable for the equipment and environment is included at no extra charge with rentals or sessions that require it. It is supplied and checked with the equipment; it is not rented separately.
strings.Leash incluido sin suplemento; pala y pr: Leash included at no extra charge; paddle and pressure checked.
